Name: Three Fires
Card text: North gains 1 VP at each own-turn start. South gains 1 VP per controlled bonfire at each own-turn start. Control: more adjacent friendly units than enemies; ties uncontrolled. Gain 1 VP per enemy defeat. First to 15 wins immediately. Shuffle four traps and five Moonstones onto nine Xs and reveal.
Digital implementation notes: 21 October map. All full hexes in chosen spawn zone eligible; tolerate a few pixels, exclude half hexes. Fire entry/end of acting unit turn: 1 damage. Trap entry: 1 damage then remove. Acted Recruits take end-fire damage (TEST).
